description: This file defines the WorkDocsClient class for interacting with the Amazon WorkDocs service in AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various API operations such as document management, user management, and resource permissions.

classes.name: WorkDocsClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the Amazon WorkDocs service, extending AwsClient with predefined methods for API operations.

methods.name: abortDocumentVersionUpload
methods.description: Initiates aborting a document version upload.

methods.name: createComment
methods.description: Creates a comment on a resource.

methods.name: createCustomMetadata
methods.description: Creates custom metadata for a resource.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user in WorkDocs.

methods.name: deleteFolderContents
methods.description: Deletes the contents of a folder.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves information about the current user.

methods.name: getDocumentPath
methods.description: Gets the path of a document.

methods.name: getFolderPath
methods.description: Gets the path of a folder.

methods.name: initiateDocumentVersionUpload
methods.description: Starts a new document version upload.

methods.name: removeAllResourcePermissions
methods.description: Removes all permissions from a resource.

methods.name: removeResourcePermission
methods.description: Removes specific permission from a resource.
